description: A personal Bloomberg-like terminal for stock and crypto quotes with a beautiful console UI
principles: Rock-solid quality over speed - every feature must be bulletproof before moving on
Comprehensive test coverage - unit tests, integration tests, edge cases
All tests must pass before a story is marked complete
No story is done until it's documented and tested
Fail fast, fail loudly - errors should be obvious and actionable

techStack.cryptoData: CoinGecko API (no auth required for basic endpoints)

testingRequirements.coverage: Minimum 90% line coverage for all new code
testingRequirements.unitTests: Every public function/method must have unit tests
testingRequirements.integrationTests: UI components tested with Textual's pilot testing framework
testingRequirements.edgeCases: Test invalid inputs, network failures, timeouts, empty responses
testingRequirements.mocking: External APIs (yfinance, CoinGecko) must be mocked in tests
testingRequirements.ci: All tests + typecheck + lint must pass before story completion

userStories.title: Project scaffold and Textual app shell
acceptanceCriteria: Python project structure with pyproject.toml (dependencies, scripts, pytest config)
pytest, pytest-asyncio, pytest-cov, mypy, ruff configured
Textual app boots and displays a header with 'VIPER TERMINAL'
Footer shows keybindings (q=quit)
App runs via 'python -m viper' or entry point
Basic color theme: green text on black background
Tests: app launches without error, header/footer render correctly
mypy passes with --strict, ruff passes with no errors
userStories.notes: Foundation for all future features. Set up testing infrastructure first.

userStories.title: Command input bar with ticker parsing
acceptanceCriteria: Input widget at bottom of screen (Bloomberg-style)
User can type a ticker symbol (e.g., AAPL, BTC)
Pressing Enter triggers a lookup action (emits event)
Input clears after submission
Show error message for empty input
Input normalizes to uppercase
Tests: input submission, empty validation, uppercase normalization, event emission
userStories.notes: Use Textual's Input widget. Test with Pilot framework.

userStories.title: Stock quote fetching with yfinance
acceptanceCriteria: Install yfinance as dependency
Create a data service module (viper/services/stock.py)
Define StockQuote dataclass with typed fields
Fetch: price, change, change%, volume, market cap, 52w high/low
Handle invalid tickers gracefully - return error result, not exception
Async wrapper to not block UI (run_in_executor)
Tests: valid ticker fetch (mocked), invalid ticker handling, network timeout, malformed response
100% test coverage on stock service module
userStories.notes: Use Ticker.fast_info for speed. All yfinance calls mocked in tests.

userStories.title: Stock quote display panel
acceptanceCriteria: QuotePanel widget displays fetched stock data
Show ticker symbol prominently at top
Green (#00ff00) for positive change, red (#ff0000) for negative
Format numbers: commas for thousands, 2 decimal places for prices
Show 'Loading...' spinner during fetch
Show error state with message when fetch fails
Empty state when no ticker selected
Tests: all display states (loading, success, error, empty), color logic, number formatting
userStories.notes: Create reusable QuotePanel widget. Snapshot tests for visual regression.

userStories.title: Crypto quote fetching with CoinGecko
acceptanceCriteria: Create crypto data service (viper/services/crypto.py)
Define CryptoQuote dataclass with typed fields
Maintain symbol->id mapping (btc->bitcoin, eth->ethereum, etc.)
Fetch: price (USD), 24h change%, market cap, 24h volume
Handle unknown symbols gracefully
Handle rate limits (429) with retry + exponential backoff
Handle network errors, timeouts
Tests: valid fetch (mocked), unknown symbol, rate limit handling, network errors
100% test coverage on crypto service module
userStories.notes: Use httpx or aiohttp for async requests. Mock all HTTP in tests.

userStories.title: Unified quote lookup with asset type detection
acceptanceCriteria: Create unified QuoteService that delegates to stock/crypto services
Support explicit prefix: 'BTC:CRYPTO', 'AAPL:STOCK'
Without prefix: check known crypto list first, then try stock
Return unified Quote type (union of StockQuote | CryptoQuote)
QuotePanel adapts display based on quote type
Tests: prefix parsing, auto-detection logic, fallback behavior, panel adaptation
userStories.notes: Keep detection logic simple and testable. Maintain crypto symbol list.

userStories.title: Quote history and quick recall
acceptanceCriteria: HistoryManager class stores last 20 looked-up tickers
Up/Down arrows in input cycle through history
History persists to ~/.config/viper/history.json
Handle missing/corrupt history file gracefully
Tests: add to history, cycle navigation, persistence, file corruption recovery
userStories.notes: Keep history logic decoupled from UI for easy testing.

userStories.title: Watchlist panel
acceptanceCriteria: WatchlistManager class handles add/remove/list operations
Commands: 'w AAPL' adds, 'd AAPL' removes
WatchlistPanel widget displays all watched tickers
Shows: ticker, last price, change% with colors
Auto-refresh every 60s (configurable)
Persist to ~/.config/viper/watchlist.json
Handle missing/corrupt file gracefully
Tests: add/remove logic, persistence, refresh timer, display formatting, file recovery
userStories.notes: Separate data management from UI widget.

userStories.title: Multi-panel layout
acceptanceCriteria: Screen divided: watchlist (30%) left, main quote (70%) right
Input bar spans full width at bottom
Header spans full width at top
Tab cycles focus between watchlist and quote panel
Visual focus indicator on active panel
Responsive: hide watchlist on very narrow terminals (<80 cols)
Tests: layout proportions, focus cycling, responsive behavior
userStories.notes: Use Textual's Grid or Horizontal containers.

userStories.title: Keyboard navigation and shortcuts
acceptanceCriteria: q = quit application
/ = focus input bar
Esc = clear input / close overlays
Tab = cycle panels
j/k = navigate lists (watchlist)
Enter on watchlist item = view that quote
? or F1 = show help (placeholder for VPR-015)
All bindings documented in code
Tests: each keybinding triggers correct action
userStories.notes: Use Textual's Bindings system. Test with Pilot.press().

userStories.title: Intraday price chart (sparkline)
acceptanceCriteria: Fetch intraday data (1d, 5m intervals) via yfinance
SparklineWidget renders ASCII line chart
Show in quote panel below price data
Label with time range
Graceful fallback when data unavailable (show 'No data')
Tests: sparkline rendering, empty data handling, time label formatting
userStories.notes: Keep chart simple - ASCII art, not full graphics.

userStories.title: Company/asset info panel
acceptanceCriteria: InfoPanel widget shows extended metadata
Stocks: sector, industry, description, website, employees
Crypto: description, website, genesis date
Toggle with 'i' key
Scrollable content for long descriptions
Tests: panel toggle, content rendering for each asset type, scrolling

userStories.title: Error handling and status bar
acceptanceCriteria: StatusBar widget at bottom shows: connection state, last refresh time
User-friendly error messages (not raw exceptions)
Network errors show 'Offline' status with retry hint
Timeout handling: 10s default, show 'Request timed out'
All errors logged to ~/.config/viper/viper.log
Log rotation: max 5MB, keep 3 backups
Tests: error message formatting, status transitions, log file creation
userStories.notes: Use Python's logging module with RotatingFileHandler.

userStories.title: Configuration file support
acceptanceCriteria: Load config from ~/.config/viper/config.toml
Configurable: refresh_interval, theme_colors, default_watchlist
Config dataclass with validation
Sensible defaults when no config exists
Invalid config values logged and fall back to defaults
Tests: config loading, missing file, invalid values, validation
userStories.notes: Use tomllib (stdlib in 3.11+). Pydantic optional for validation.

userStories.title: Help screen and onboarding
acceptanceCriteria: HelpScreen modal opens with F1 or ?
Lists all commands and keybindings in organized sections
Brief description of each feature
Esc or Enter dismisses modal
First-run detection: show welcome on first launch
Tests: help screen content, dismiss behavior, first-run logic
userStories.notes: Use Textual's ModalScreen. Store first-run flag in config.

stocks.notes: Free, no API key, wraps Yahoo Finance. Rate limits unknown but generous for personal use.

crypto.notes: Free tier: 30 calls/min, 10k/month. No auth for basic endpoints.
